name: linear
purpose: Issues, projects and cycles in Linear

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.help: Linear → Settings → Security & access → Personal API keys

guide:
The Linear GraphQL API (https://developers.linear.app), as the person. A query reads; a mutation is a change and asks the person first.

```sh
curl -s -X POST https://api.linear.app/graphql -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"{ viewer { name assignedIssues(first: 10, filter: {state: {type: {nin: [\"completed\",\"canceled\"]}}}) { nodes { identifier title state { name } } } } }"}'
```
